blocks.text: Jab tay ho jaye ke masla solvable hai, to agla sawal us ki computational complexity ka hota hai, yani woh kitni efficiency se hal ho sakta hai. Hal karne ke liye zaroori resources (waqt aur space yani memory) ki base par maslon ko tractable ya intractable kaha jata hai.

Tractable Problems (jo manageable waqt mein hal hon): masla tractable hai agar woh polynomial time mein hal ho sake; ise P se zahir karte hain. Polynomial time ka matlab hai ke input ka size barhne par hal ka waqt manageable (sambhalne ke qabil) raftar se (polynomial function ki tarah, jaise n, n² ya n³) barhta hai. Tractable maslon ko "efficiently solvable" (efficiency se hal hone wale) samjha jata hai.

Misal: Merge Sort ya Quick Sort jaise algorithms se numbers ki list sort karna (tarteeb dena) tractable masla hai, kyun ke in algorithms ki time complexity O(n log n) hai, jahan n list mein elements ki ginti hai.

Intractable Problems (jin mein bohat hi zyada waqt lage): yeh woh masle hain jinhein hal karne ke liye super-polynomial waqt chahiye, jo aksar input ke size ke saath exponentially (bohat tezi se, jaise 2ⁿ) barhta hai. Bare inputs ke liye inhein hal karna asal mein mumkin nahi, kyun ke lagne wala waqt qabu se bahar ho jata hai.

Misal: Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP), jis mein aisa sab se chhota raasta dhoondna hota hai jo shehron ke ek group se guzar kar wapas shuru wali jagah aaye, intractable masle ki misal hai. Yeh masla NP-hard hai: shehar barhne par mumkin raaston ki ginti factorially barhti hai, is liye bare cases ko bilkul sahi (exactly) hal karna mumkin nahi rehta. Factorially ka matlab: n se 1 tak tamam whole numbers (poore numbers) ko aapas mein multiply karna.

items: 2 shehron ke liye: 2! = 2 x 1 = 2 mumkin raaste.
3 shehron ke liye: 3! = 3 x 2 x 1 = 6 mumkin raaste.
4 shehron ke liye: 4! = 4 x 3 x 2 x 1 = 24 mumkin raaste.

blocks.text: Aap dekh sakte hain ke shehar barhane par mumkin raaston ki ginti bohat tezi se barhti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab shehron ki har tarteeb (n!) ko ek raasta ginti hai. Agar shuru ka shehar tay ho aur ulta chakkar alag na gina jaye to alag chakkar (n - 1)!/2 bante hain; magar yeh ginti bhi factorial ki tarah hi tezi se barhti hai, is liye nateeja wahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Tractable aur intractable maslon ko compare kijiye (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Dono solvable hain. Tractable maslon ke polynomial-time algorithms hain, jin ka waqt input barhne par manageable rehta hai (jaise sorting, O(n log n)). Intractable maslon ko super-polynomial (aksar exponential) waqt chahiye, is liye bare inputs par sahi hal asal mein na-mumkin ho jata hai (jaise bohat se shehron wala TSP).

items: Tractable: polynomial time (Merge Sort O(n log n)).
Intractable: super-polynomial time (TSP; raaste n! ki tarah barhte hain: 2, 6, 24, ...).
